$4.$ 若 $\int_{-\pi}^{\pi} (x - a_1 \cos x - b_1 \sin x)^2 dx = \min\limits_{a,b \in \mathbf{R}} \left\{ \int_{-\pi}^{\pi} (x - a \cos x - b \sin x)^2 dx \right\}$，则 $a_1 \cos x + b_1 \sin x =$ $( )$

$(A)$ $2\sin x \qquad(B)$ $2\cos x \qquad (C)$ $2\pi\sin x \qquad(D)$ $2\pi\cos x$
